newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume rises to 642 kilos.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume rises to 642 kilos.

text.p: The Istanbul gold exchange volume rose to 642 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 270 kilos on minor free market demand ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at 1,443,900 lira per kilo versus Thursday's 1,439,800 lira due to the underlying weakness of the Turkish lira although U.S. dollar prices fell.
Gold closed at $350 an ounce, down from Wednesday's $352. There was no trading in dollar terms on Thursday.
The Turkish currency closed easier at 128,340 from 127,950 yesterday to the U.S. dollar.
Of the day's trade, 372 kilos of gold changed hands in the morning and 84.4 percent was conducted in lira terms.
